label: saves
name: Save menu
description: Merges the slot 1 and slot 2 menus into one, so that you don't have to worry about which one to select. Requires "speed up on memory card access" to not feel like a slog.

label: mark
name: Black Mark
description: Makes Masao Inaba black. It uses a custom sprite I made for him so that he's both black and still wears his original outfit. Doesn't change the script.

label: battlespeed
name: Battle speedup
description: Doubles the speed of summons and skill effects in battle.

label: 60fps
name: 60 FPS
description: Interpolates frames to get the dungeons to 60fps and the map to 30fps. Only does it when you're actively moving around. Needs overclocking.

label: rewards
name: Double rewards
description: Doubles the EXP, Persona points and money you get after battles.

label: encounters
name: Half encounters
description: Halves the rate of random encounters.

label: run
name: Run in dungeons
description: Hold Cross to walk and turn at double speed in the 3D dungeons. The controller page lists it as RUN/CANCEL on Cross in both control schemes.

label: upright
name: Upper-right movement
description: Forces Upward Movement Orientation to Upper Right: pressing Up walks to the upper right in the 2D rooms instead of the retail upper left.
